note: Maps spec rows (spec/target-spec.md, T-01..T-30) to committed records. A row with no entry reads not-yet-measured. Add an entry when its record lands; never edit a spec target to make a row pass. Fields: record (repo path), field (dotted path; [name=X] picks a list item by its name), op (>= <= ==), value or value_field (sibling field of the same record), corner, scope (CH, TC, BOTH or n/a), basis (what the number is), note.

T-05.basis: RTL simulation, every single-fault position (41 cases)
T-05.note: RTL leg only. The SIM leg (mux added load and delay inside T-12/T-13) is not measured.
Repair claim in CH needs an assembly; the mux function is what this record covers.

T-27.basis: RTL simulation, N = 20, DDR latency testbench
T-27.note: The record carries the testbench verdict, not the cycle count.

T-09.basis: simulated, failing T-09 measurements over 720 corner-measurements (DR-0017 driver, head 282a9d4)
T-09.note: Simulated, not measured. Binding corner mos_tt/mixed/-40C, t09_dwell_over_a = 0.0 (no dwell above the level).

T-09.basis: simulated, failing T-09 measurements, L2 wire-bond loopback (reported separately from CH)
T-09.note: Simulated, not measured. TC result only, not a CH claim. The spec expects TC to possibly fail the CH limit; here it did not.

T-19.basis: simulated pre-layout Monte Carlo, worst draw of 900 (20 per corner, mismatch), aperture = setup + hold at the D-pin 50 % crossing, ps
T-19.note: Simulated, not measured. A cell property from ideal 100 ps edges; holds for CH and TC only as far as the declared edge slew does (record claim_scope). Pooled grid.

T-19.basis: simulated pre-layout, klt yield sigma-to-spec (one-sided, target 7 = the 14 sigma peak-to-peak reading)
T-19.note: Normal-model figure; the distribution is not normal (Anderson-Darling rejected), the empirical yield 900/900 and the worst draw are the tail used.

T-22.basis: layout-measured, klt stats bounding box width of the drawn aib_io_tx unit cell, pad included, um
T-22.note: Layout-measured, pre-extraction: the bounding box of the drawn cell, not an extracted figure. Exactly at the 55 um target, no margin, so the 80 um fallback is not invoked. The same cell is in CH and TC, and the number is geometric, so it does not differ between them.

T-22.basis: layout-measured, half the klt stats bounding box width of the abutted aib_io_tx_clk pair, um
T-22.note: The abutment leg of the spec's evidence column: the abutted pair measures 110.0 um, so the pitch holds under abutment and not only for a cell in isolation.

T-23.basis: layout-measured, klt stats bounding box area of the drawn aib_io_tx unit cell (55 x 100 um), pad included, um2
T-23.note: The LAYOUT (klt stats) figure the spec row's evidence column and DR-0013 call for once the cell exists; it supersedes the ANALYSIS estimate the row is labelled with. Layout-measured, pre-extraction, I/O cell only (pad, ESD, driver or receiver). Exactly at the 5500 um2 limit, no margin.
